test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

We will / have been know the result / of the CAT exam by next week.

options.text: of the CAT exam by next week

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"have been know the result"** is grammatically **incorrect**.
 
• The correct formulation should use a future perfect tense, **"will have known."**
 
• This tense is used to indicate that something will be completed at some point in the future.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is- ***"We will have known the result of the CAT exam by next week."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **of the CAT exam by next week**: This segment is correctly formulated to indicate the time frame and subject matter.
 
• **We will:** This segment correctly starts the sentence, indicating future action.
